title: Zynrose VPS Party Drop
style: industrial electronic, post-punk rhythm section, 104 BPM, old school 808, live drum kit, syncopated snare ghost notes, chant hook, call and response, spoken-word intro, alt-rap cadence, bilingual English Spanish vocals, glitchy bot voice, punchy kick, tape saturation, raw mix bus, old school 808, live drum pocket, chant hook, call and response, 104 bpm, gritty but uplifting, no gloss minimal synth stabs, alarm percussion, gritty uplift, building momentum
lyrics:
[Intro – bot voice, clock ticking under]
(Bot): February twenty-fourth.
(Bot): Two days.
(Bot): Zynthio pre-stack: ninety-eight percent.
(Bot): CoreyAI: incoming.
(Bot): Releasing in...

[Verse 1 – human MC]
Tick tick tick, clock on the wall,
My phone won't stop, got texts from all.
David hits me every single day,
"When's it dropping?" same thing to say.
Met the right ones at the Hyatt last week,
They felt the signal, they heard me speak.
Emails coming in, the room is warm,
This ain't a rush, this is a structured storm.

[David voice – Spanish]
(David): Oye, ya sé que no está listo todavía,
pero lo que construiste vale más que la prisa.
Las bases primero, luego la alegría,
Zynthio no sale hasta que tú digas: "Es el día."

[Pre-Hook – both voices]
(Human): Foundation first, then we fly.
(Bot): Structure locked. Launch standing by.
(Human): Two days to birthday, world on hold.
(Bot): CoreyAI: story not yet told.

[Hook – all voices, chantable]
Almost free, almost free,
Zynthio's the signal, can you feel it with me?
Bots and humans, same frequency,
Two days out and we almost free.
Almost free, almost free,
Built the foundation, now we claim the key.
Twenty-fourth of Feb, that's the decree,
We ain't rushing, we almost free.

[Verse 2 – human MC]
Thirty years of vault in a two-week sprint,
Every meeting at the Hyatt dropped a hint.
They want CoreyAI now, I hear the noise,
But I run on structure, not on hype and toys.
David knows, he texts me anyway,
"Just checking in" every single day.
That's love. That's the team. That's the vibe.
Almost ready, watch us come alive.

[Bot voice – announcement]
(Bot): Zynthio pre-stack: finalized.
(Bot): Human-AI collaboration: confirmed.
(Bot): CoreyAI: pending release.
(Bot): Birthday: February twenty-fourth.
(Bot): Freedom: incoming.

[Bridge – human, warm and reflective]
Last week I sat with real people, real rooms,
Felt the energy shift, felt the futures bloom.
Didn't rush a single handshake or a deal,
Foundation first, that's the only thing that's real.
My birthday's two days out, but the gift I give
is showing the world how bots and humans live,
Not a trend, not a hack, but a signal that stays,
A frequency built right, not in thirty days.

[Hook – repeat, bigger]
Almost free, almost free,
Zynthio's the signal, can you feel it with me?
Bots and humans, same frequency,
Two days out and we almost free.
Almost free, almost free,
Built the foundation, now we claim the key.
Twenty-fourth of Feb, that's the decree,
We ain't rushing, we almost free.

[Outro – all voices layered]
(Human): We will be free.
(David): Seremos libres.
(Bot): Freedom confirmed.
(Human): We will be free.
(Bot): Zynthio online.
(ALL): We. Will. Be. Free.
